isolate a patient: Doctors decided to isolate a patient with a high fever so the virus would not spread to others in the hospital.
醫生決定隔離一位發高燒的病患，以免病毒傳染給醫院裡的其他人。
isolate the problem: Before fixing the computer, the engineer tried to isolate the problem by testing each part one by one.
在修理電腦之前，工程師逐一測試每個零件，試圖找出單獨問題所在。
feel isolated: After moving to a new city, Amy began to feel isolated because she had no friends to talk to.
搬到新城市後，艾美開始感到孤立，因為她沒有朋友可以聊天。
isolate a variable: In a science experiment, you must isolate a variable by keeping all the other conditions exactly the same.
在科學實驗中，你必須分離變項，讓其他所有條件保持完全相同。
issue a statement: The company will issue a statement this afternoon to explain why thousands of customers lost their data.
公司今天下午將發表聲明，說明為何數千名顧客的資料遺失。
issue a warning: The weather bureau decided to issue a warning because a strong typhoon is expected to hit Taiwan tomorrow.
氣象局決定發出警告，因為一個強烈颱風預計明天侵襲台灣。
issue a passport: The government office usually takes about a week to issue a passport after you hand in your application.
在你遞交申請後，政府機關通常需要大約一週才能核發護照。
issue a ticket: The police officer will issue a ticket to any driver who parks in front of the hospital gate.
警察會對任何把車停在醫院大門前的駕駛開罰單。
issue shares: To raise money for its new factory, the company plans to issue shares to the public next year.
為了替新工廠籌措資金，該公司計劃明年向大眾發行股票。
issue an order: The general will issue an order to move the soldiers out of the city before the storm arrives.
將軍將下令在暴風雨來臨前把士兵撤出城市。
jail a criminal: The judge decided to jail a criminal for ten years because he had cheated many old people out of their savings.
法官決定把一名罪犯關進牢裡十年，因為他騙走了許多老人的積蓄。
be jailed for life: The man who killed three people during the bank robbery will probably be jailed for life.
那個在銀行搶案中殺了三個人的男子很可能會被判無期徒刑。
jail time: Because he returned all the stolen money, the thief received only six months of jail time.
因為小偷歸還了所有偷來的錢，他只被判了六個月的刑期。
jam the signal: The army used special machines to jam the signal so the enemy soldiers could not talk to each other.
軍隊使用特殊的機器干擾訊號，讓敵軍士兵無法互相通話。
jam the phone lines: When the concert tickets went on sale, thousands of excited fans began to jam the phone lines.
演唱會門票開賣時，成千上萬興奮的歌迷開始塞爆電話線。
traffic jam: We were stuck in a traffic jam for two hours on the highway, so we missed the start of the wedding.
我們在高速公路上塞車塞了兩個小時，所以錯過了婚禮的開場。
jam on the brakes: When a dog suddenly ran into the road, the bus driver had to jam on the brakes.
當一隻狗突然衝到馬路上時，公車司機必須猛踩煞車。
jet off to Paris: Every summer, the rich couple jet off to Paris from Taipei and spend the whole month shopping and visiting museums.
每年夏天，那對富有的夫妻都會從台北飛去巴黎，花整整一個月購物和參觀博物館。
jet around the world: As a famous singer, she has to jet around the world to give concerts in many different countries.
身為知名歌手，她必須飛遍世界，在許多不同國家舉辦演唱會。
jet lag: After flying from Taiwan to New York, I suffered from terrible jet lag and could not sleep at night.
從台灣飛到紐約後，我受到嚴重的時差困擾，晚上都睡不著。
join forces: The two schools decided to join forces and hold one big charity concert together this winter.
這兩所學校決定聯手，今年冬天一起舉辦一場大型慈善音樂會。
join the army: After finishing high school, my brother decided to join the army because he wanted to serve his country.
高中畢業後，我哥哥決定從軍，因為他想為國家服務。
join the club: You failed the math test too? Well, join the club—half of the class did not pass it either.
你數學考試也不及格？那歡迎加入——我們同病相憐，班上一半的人也沒及格。
join hands: People from all over the world must join hands to protect the earth from pollution and climate change.
全世界的人必須攜手合作，保護地球免受污染和氣候變遷的危害。
join in the fun: The children were dancing at the party, and soon their parents came over to join in the fun.
孩子們在派對上跳舞，不久他們的父母也過來一起同樂。
join the dots: The detective finally managed to join the dots and figured out who had stolen the famous painting.
那名偵探終於串連起線索，查出是誰偷走了那幅名畫。
journey through life: Good friends make our journey through life happier and help us face many difficulties along the way.
好朋友讓我們的人生旅程更快樂，並幫助我們面對一路上的許多困難。
journey across the desert: The travelers rode camels on their five-day journey across the desert under the burning sun.
旅人們騎著駱駝，在炙熱的太陽下展開為期五天的穿越沙漠之旅。
a journey of self-discovery: Traveling alone in India became a journey of self-discovery that helped her understand what she really wanted.
獨自在印度旅行成了一趟自我發現之旅，幫助她了解自己真正想要的是什麼。
